note: RFC 4271 Section 9 requires running the Decision Process once Adj-RIB-In is updated. TestRFC4271AdjRIBInUpdateRunsTheDecisionProcess feeds an UPDATE to handleReceivedStructured with no external trigger and asserts Loc-RIB installation and BestChangeAdd. TestRFC4271AdjRIBInUpdateThatDisplacesTheBestReselects withdraws peer A's better route and asserts the Decision Process runs again and selects peer B's remaining route in Loc-RIB.
